purpose: Own initialization-send and worker message-deserialization failures through the same session cancellation and cleanup boundary.

contract.completion: Worker readiness resolves on readiness or session cleanup; worker/application errors go through the existing fail/cancel boundary. An initialization postMessage exception must not leak an unhandled readiness rejection or prompt for a camera.
contract.ownership: A worker messageerror fails the current run immediately during startup or processing, clears timers, aborts capture, stops owned tracks and terminates/disposes the worker. Late events/results cannot fail a replacement; restart remains explicit.
contract.verification: Reproduce native structured-clone initialization failure leaking an unhandled rejection and a synthetic messageerror retaining a running session. Retain real WASM/model and all earlier controls. Unit checks cover both initial modes, readiness, acquisition, presenter, result/capture waits, cleanup, exact timer inactivity and late callbacks. Browser fault injection does not qualify physical phone deserialization or OS failure behavior.
contract.preservation: Preserve prior camera/renderer evidence, scientific JSON, frozen native artifacts, resolved lock and release WASM. No Rust/core/GPU/dependency change, compilation, sensor or new SDK/model/toolchain acquisition.

resources.strategy: Fresh E: site with hash-checked vendor hardlinks and reused release WASM. All local command inputs are source-bound; preserve previous outputs and failures.
resources.asset_download_scope: No new local SDK/model acquisition. Expanded public failure/restart controls may stream up to 40MiB without retaining vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Canonical calibration/timing, independent real motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying physical Linux hardware and integrated operational acceptance remain open.
